verse.verse_2: By the manifest Book that makes things clear.
verse.verse_3: We sent it down on a blessed night. Verily, We are ever warning.
verse.verse_4: Therein (that night) is decreed every matter, Hakim.
verse.verse_5: As a command from Us. Verily, We are ever sending,
verse.verse_6: (As) a mercy from your Lord. Verily, He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower.
verse.verse_7: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if you (but) have a faith with certainty.
verse.verse_8: La ilaha illa Huwa. He gives life and causes death -- your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.
verse.verse_9: Nay! They play about in doubt.
verse.verse_10: Then wait you for the Day when the sky will bring forth a visible smoke,
verse.verse_11: Covering mankind, this is a painful torment.
verse.verse_12: (They will say): "Our Lord! Remove the torment from us, really we shall become believers!"
verse.verse_13: How can there be for them an admonition, when a Messenger explaining things clearly has already come to them.
verse.verse_14: Then they had turned away from him and said: "(He is) one taught, a madman!"
verse.verse_15: Verily, We shall remove the torment for a while. Verily, you will revert.
verse.verse_16: On the Day when We shall strike you with the great Batshah. Verily, We will exact retribution.
verse.verse_17: And indeed We tried before them Fir`awn's people, when there came to them a noble Messenger.
verse.verse_18: Saying: "Deliver to me the servants of Allah. Verily, I am to you a Messenger worthy of all trust."
verse.verse_19: "And exalt not yourselves against Allah. Truly, I have come to you with a manifest authority."
verse.verse_20: "And truly, I seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord, lest you should stone me."
verse.verse_21: "But if you believe me not, then keep away from me and leave me alone."
verse.verse_22: So he (Musa) called upon his Lord (saying): "These are indeed the people who are criminals."
verse.verse_23: (Allah said): "Depart you with My servants by night. Surely, you will be pursued."
verse.verse_24: "And leave the sea as it is (quiet and divided). Verily, they are a host to be drowned."
verse.verse_25: How many of gardens and springs that they (Fir`awn's people) left behind,
verse.verse_26: And green crops (fields) and goodly places,
verse.verse_27: And comforts of life wherein they used to take delight!
verse.verse_28: Thus (it was)! And We made other people inherit them.
verse.verse_29: And the heavens and the earth wept not for them, nor were they given respite.
verse.verse_30: And indeed We saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment,
verse.verse_31: From Fir`awn; verily, he was arrogant and was of the excessive.
verse.verse_32: And We chose them above the nations (Al-`Alamin) with knowledge,
verse.verse_33: And granted them signs in which there was a plain trial.
verse.verse_35: "There is nothing but our first death, and we shall not be resurrected."
verse.verse_36: "Then bring back our forefathers, if you speak the truth!"
verse.verse_37: Are they better or the people of Tubba` and those before them We destroyed them because they were indeed criminals.
verse.verse_38: And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, for mere play.
verse.verse_39: We created them not except with truth, but most of them know not.
verse.verse_40: Verily, the Day of Judgement is the time appointed for all of them --
verse.verse_41: The Day when a near relative cannot avail a near relative in aught, and no help can they receive,
verse.verse_42: Except him on whom Allah has mercy. Verily, He is the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.
verse.verse_44: Will be the food of the sinners.
verse.verse_45: Like boiling oil, it will boil in the bellies,
verse.verse_46: Like the boiling of scalding water.
verse.verse_47: (It will be said:) "Seize him and drag him into the midst of blazing Fire,"
verse.verse_48: "Then pour over his head the torment of boiling water."
verse.verse_49: "Taste you (this)! Verily, you were (pretending to be) the mighty, the generous."
verse.verse_50: "Verily, this is that whereof you used to doubt!"
verse.verse_51: Verily, those who have Taqwa, will be in place of security.
verse.verse_53: Dressed in Sundus and Istabraq, facing each other,
verse.verse_54: So (it will be). And We shall marry them to Hur (fair females) with wide lovely eyes,
verse.verse_55: They will call therein for every kind of fruit in peace and security;
verse.verse_56: They will never taste death therein except the first death, and He will save them from the torment of the blazing Fire,
verse.verse_57: As a bounty from your Lord! That will be the supreme success!
verse.verse_58: Certainly, We have made this easy in your tongue, in order that they may remember.
verse.verse_59: Wait then; verily, they (too) are waiting.
